findings.summary: Clearance-step status is shown as a raw Material Chip displaying the untranslated English status token (e.g. 'completed'/'blocked') instead of the shared MobileStatusPill.
findings.fix: Replace `trailing: Chip(label: Text(step.status))` with `trailing: MobileStatusPill(step.status)` so the status uses the shared Arabic label + status color palette; import mobile_widgets.dart.

findings.summary: Asset rows use a bespoke Material Chip ('مطلوب الإرجاع') instead of the shared pill styling, giving inconsistent chip radius/color versus the rest of the app.
findings.fix: Use MobileStatusPill (or a styled pill matching the status palette) rather than a plain `Chip`, keeping chip radius 99 and status-color conventions consistent with other pages.

findings.summary: Section titles ('خطوات الإخلاء', 'العهد المطلوب إرجاعها') are hand-rolled titleLarge Text widgets rather than the shared MobileSectionHeader used across all other mobile pages.
findings.fix: Replace the two inline title Text blocks (lines 71-76 and 96-101) with `MobileSectionHeader(title: ...)` for consistent section header typography and spacing.

findings.summary: The no-case empty state and the error state are bare left-aligned/centered Text with no brand logo, title/subtitle hierarchy, or retry action, unlike the app's standard empty/error treatment.
findings.fix: Wrap the empty state (line 32-44) in a centered column with BrandLogoMark + a titled subtitle, and give the error state (line 22-30) a retry button that calls `ref.invalidate(myOffboardingPortalProvider)`.

findings.summary: The clearance step list has no empty state; if `data.clearance` is empty the section header renders with nothing beneath it, unlike the assets section which has an explicit empty card.
findings.fix: Mirror the assets pattern (line 102-108): when `data.clearance.isEmpty`, render a Card with a 'لا توجد خطوات إخلاء.' message instead of an empty gap.

findings.summary: Status inside the summary card is printed as raw interpolated text 'الحالة: ${item['status']}' showing the untranslated English token instead of a MobileStatusPill.
findings.fix: Render the case status via `MobileStatusPill(item['status'] as String)` next to the label rather than interpolating the raw status string.

findings.summary: Card inner padding is inconsistent: the summary/empty cards use EdgeInsets.all(18) while ListTile-based cards use default padding, and the design system standard is not uniformly applied.
findings.fix: Standardize card content padding (e.g. all(16) or all(18)) across the summary card, empty cards and list rows to match the design-system card padding used elsewhere.

findings.summary: The status leading icons in clearance steps convey completed/blocked/pending purely by icon shape with no Semantics label and no color differentiation, hurting screen-reader and low-vision users.
findings.fix: Add a Semantics label (or tooltip) describing the step status to the leading Icon and tint it via the status color palette so state is conveyed by more than icon shape alone.
